dct_description_sm: A Municipal Address Number (Civic Number) is a number used for the purpose of identifying a building or property on a particular street. The objective of municipal addressing is to maintain a consistent system for the addressing of buildings to assist emergency services. Modern day emergency dispatch systems rely on accurate civic addressing to support emergency response personnel.
